d: A sweeping Reuters investigation has exposed the extensive network convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein built across Russia—tracing how he exploited fashion pipelines to traffic young women from the former Soviet Union while aggressively pursuing ties with Russian oligarchs and Kremlin insiders.
